contentText:
Olivia Rodrigo reveals which song from her new album you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love was her favorite to write, the inspiration behind creating the all-female Daisy Chain festival (which is a month away) and her favorite thing to eat after her shows at her LEGO x Olivia Rodrigo Vinyl event in Los Angeles.

Tetris Kelly
Yeah, we dropped dead when we got to get up close and personal with Olivia Rodrigo at her exclusive Lego pop-up, where she got intimate with fans.

Olivia Rodrigo
I have like a crazy running list of things in my notes app that I want to write about.

We take you there in Billboard All Access. LEGO and Olivia transported fans to a record store in Studio City, California. They packed in for the cool photo ops. There was a DJ playing her classics, and they peeked at all her iconic Lego sets, like a vinyl, a slick guitar, and her moon stage. They were even treated to gifts and giveaways like Fro-Yo and Olivia drink coasters. Before being surprised by Olivia herself, she had the cutest interaction with the fans singing “Stupid Song” before starting a Q and A.

I feel like writing “Honey Bee” was really fun, and it happened in like a really short amount of time, and it’s always fun when the song just like comes out. And yeah, I remember like listening to it after and like having tears in my eyes because it was just like so perfectly captured the way I felt. You know, Sarah McLachlan or Kathleen Hanna, who just like totally paved the way and like are unafraid to speak about issues and you know write songs from the heart. So probably probably those girls. But yeah, great question. I’m so excited, it’s only a month away. Because after every important show that I do with the Grammys or SNL , I always get a Five Guys cheeseburger.

Liv posted to socials after the event a video of her hiding Lego vinyls. Can you snag one? I was so happy to snag a LEGO set myself before heading out. Thanks for the great day, Olivia.
